ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #18
====

GRADE: Grade 3
SUBJECT: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Weather and its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Weather and its resources.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Weather and its resources.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Weather and its resources.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Weather and its resources.

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Animals and its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Animals and its resources.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Animals and its resources.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Animals and its resources.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Animals and its resources.

3. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Iron rusting
   B. Paper burning to ash
   C. Ice melting to water
   D. Milk souring

4. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   B. Overgrazing continuously
   C. Removing all vegetation
   D. Burning crop residue every week

5. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   B. Water removes heat too quickly
   C. Water always increases oxygen
   D. Petrol fires have no fuel

6. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any substance that conducts electricity
   B. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   C. A mixture of two liquids
   D. Any white crystal used in cooking

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Keeping safe in? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Keeping safe in.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Keeping safe in.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Keeping safe in.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Keeping safe in.

8. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only water vapour
   B. Glucose and oxygen
   C. Nitrogen gas only
   D. Only carbon dioxide

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Water its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Water its resources.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Water its resources.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Water its resources.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Water its resources.

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Dangers of heat? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Dangers of heat.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Dangers of heat.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Dangers of heat.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Dangers of heat.

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Harmonious? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Harmonious.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Harmonious.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Harmonious.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Harmonious.

12. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 50 °C
   B. 37 °C
   C. 100 °C
   D. 0 °C

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Communicating messages and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Engaging parents or and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Caring for Soil environment and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Improving soil and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. A — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Weather and its resources.

2. A — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Animals and its resources.

3. C — Ice melting to water

4. A — Planting cover crops and terracing slopes

5. A — Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely

6. B — A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means

7. C — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Keeping safe in.

8. B — Glucose and oxygen

9. A — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Water its resources.

10. C — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Dangers of heat.

11. C — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Harmonious.

12. C — 100 °C

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Caring for Soil environment; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Improving soil; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
